√chid (chinátti; cicchéda; ácchaitsīt;
chetsyáti; chinná; chéttum; chittvā́;
-chídya; chidyáte).
 —1. cut off; hew
down; sever; cut in two; nibble;
 —2.
divide. [cf. σχίζω, √σχιδ, ‘split’; Lat.
scindo, scidi, ‘cut’; AS. sceādan, ‘divide,’
[]
Eng. water-shed, ‘the divide between two
valleys.’]
+ ud,
 —1. cut out;
 —2. destroy; --pass.
be cut off, fail, be lacking.
+ vi, cut asunder; sever.

chidrá, n. hole; defect; weak spot.
